raw.rationale: This compound is an iron-chelating agent (deferasirox-like) whose PRISM activity at 2.5 µM for 5 days is likely driven by iron deprivation rather than UGT1A6 inhibition, and iron-chelator sensitivity is generally broad and modest rather than lineage-selective; published PRISM data show few, if any, lineages meeting the strict selective-kill criteria. Thus probabilities are near the low base rate for all lineages, with slight elevations for liver and bone marrow-derived lines due to iron handling and proliferation dependence.
